contact.name: Naomi Sebastine
contact.evidence_quote: One of the most memorable moments of the evening came from outgoing Students’ Union President, Naomi Sebastine, whose moving address reflected on the challenges faced by students during the past year. Naomi spoke proudly of the work undertaken by the Students’ Union to advocate for students and improve their overall university experience, while acknowledging the collective efforts of officers, staff, and partners who contributed to that progress.
